items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Did you make some records with Richard M. Jones too? ... No, I remember the band because I used all of my band. Just Richard on piano.

ctx.x: I'm going to try to finish this up so that we can get some rest. Yeah. I wanted to ask a little bit about the records you made. There's hardly room on here. We can start it here and I'll run it in another five minutes and we'll be through. Yeah. Did you make some records with Richard M. Jones too? Yeah. Do you remember which company or what the titles were and who else was in the band?
No, I remember the band because I used all of my band. Just Richard on piano.
